titulo.alumno:
«Проценты и границы опроса»
Percentages and the limits of a survey

intro: A figure describes only the population, question and period measured; check non-response, sample size and selection method.

texto: A figure describes only the population, question and period measured; check non-response, sample size and selection method.
Percentages can add up to more than one hundred if several answers are allowed; check the methodological note.
